mainEntity.name: Why is it done inside the mouth?

acceptedAnswer.text: Working from inside the mouth lets the laser reach the deep submucosal layers of the cheek and jawline without traversing the surface skin. This means stronger collagen stimulation in the right plane with less impact on the epidermis. A specialised intra-oral handpiece is used for this purpose.

Subtle changes are perceived after the second session. The visible lift develops over 8–12 weeks as new collagen organises and contracts the connective tissue. The result is gradual rather than dramatic — natural is the goal.

mainEntity.name: Does it hurt or affect speech?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is a warm sensation during the pulses and mild post-session tenderness inside the mouth that resolves within hours. Normal speaking, eating and drinking resume the same day. We may recommend rinsing with a gentle non-alcoholic mouthwash for 1–2 days after.

hero.title: Fotona Vector Lift in Miami
hero.lede: Vector Lift uses Fotona's intra-oral Nd:YAG handpiece to deliver gentle heat to the deeper layers of the lower face from inside the mouth, lifting and tightening the jowls and jawline.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Lifts the jawline and softens jowls through deep collagen stimulation delivered from inside the mouth.
Targets the lower third of the face with minimal effect on the surface skin.
Non-ablative, non-injectable — no needles, no incisions, no significant downtime.
Each session lasts 30–45 minutes; protocol typically 3–4 sessions spaced 3–4 weeks apart.
Pairs naturally with neuromodulators, jawline filler or Fotona 4D for compounded definition.
Especially useful for patients who want pre-surgical tightening or wish to avoid surgery.
